summary: The bridge is unchanged since 0.10.4; its Helm chart moves from wire-server to this repository, follows the bridge version and checks its configuration at render time.

changes.description: The chart is published at oci://quay.io/wire/charts/stable/ldap-scim-bridge and its version follows the bridge (6.0.0) instead of wire-server (5.x). Install from the new OCI repository with --version 6.0.0.

The chart requires Kubernetes 1.21 or later: the batch/v1beta1 CronJob fallback and the kubeVersionOverride value are gone. Upgrade the cluster to Kubernetes 1.21 or later before upgrading the chart, and drop kubeVersionOverride from your values.

The render fails unless config holds the whole bridge configuration or existingSecret names a Secret with a config.yaml key; the old chart rendered an empty configuration. Set config (LDAP and SCIM endpoints, credentials, mapping) or existingSecret before running helm upgrade.
The render also fails when tls, codec, search.objectClass, scimTarget.path or logLevel is missing from config. Set every key docs/configuration.md lists as required.
existingSecret mounts an operator-managed configuration (a Secret with a config.yaml key) instead of Helm values.
Optional image pull secrets (image.pullSecrets) for private registries and air-gapped mirrors; none by default.
The image tag defaults to the chart appVersion; remove a pinned image.tag 0.10.4 from your values.

migrations.description: Switch the release to the chart from oci://quay.io/wire/charts/stable/ldap-scim-bridge with helm upgrade, keeping the release name; reapply the Active Directory CA patch afterwards when you use one.

configuration.description: Now required unless existingSecret is set; the render checks every key the bridge parser needs.
Name of a Secret holding config.yaml; replaces config when set.
Was 0.10.4; empty now means the chart appVersion. Remove a pinned 0.10.4 from your values.
Existing image pull Secrets; none by default.
Already read by the template, now declared and documented in values.yaml; no action needed.
Undeclared value used for the batch/v1beta1 fallback; remove it from your values.
